title: Report: Cowboys plan to use second-round RFA tender on T.J. Bass

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: Cowboys plan to use second-round RFA tender on T.J. Bass
sources.description: The Cowboys are trying to work out a multi-year deal with kicker Brandon Aubrey before he becomes a restricted free agent and they are reportedly preparing a tender offer for another one of their impending restricted free agents.
